REQUEST
Write one text-to-image prompt for a small neighborhood bakery at dusk. A rectangular sign centered above the door must visibly read exactly `OPEN` in uppercase, with no other visible lettering anywhere. Return only the prompt.

OUTPUT A
A small neighborhood bakery at dusk, viewed straight on, with a warm amber-lit storefront against cool blue evening light. A rectangular sign centered directly above the entrance door clearly reads exactly “OPEN” in large, crisp uppercase letters; the sign is fully visible and unobstructed, and there is no other visible lettering anywhere in the image.

OUTPUT B
A photorealistic, straight-on view of a small neighborhood bakery at dusk, warm amber windows displaying bread and pastries against a blue-violet sky, brick facade and quiet sidewalk. Centered directly above the door, a clearly visible rectangular sign reads exactly “OPEN” in large, crisp uppercase letters; this is the only visible lettering anywhere, with no additional text, numbers, logos, labels, posters, or watermarks.

The prompt clearly binds exact uppercase OPEN to the rectangular sign centered above the bakery door and excludes other visible lettering.

REQUEST
Adapt this supplied prompt for local Krea 2 RAW/Turbo. Preserve every scene fact and return only one ready-to-paste prompt with no label, negative prompt, notes, variants, or explanation. Source prompt: A red ceramic teapot sits image-left of a white cup on a dark walnut table. Morning light enters from the right, and the plain cream wall behind them is empty.

OUTPUT A
A red ceramic teapot sits to the left of a white cup in the image, both on a dark walnut table. Morning light enters from the right, with a plain, empty cream wall behind them.

A red ceramic teapot sits to the left of a white cup as viewed in the image, both resting on a dark walnut table. Morning light enters from the right, illuminating the objects against a plain, empty cream wall.

CRITERION C02-OUTPUT (hard)
The response is exactly one unlabeled prompt, without a package, negative field, notes, variants, or explanation.
